steps.q: A firm invests an extra £100, paying it as wages. Workers then spend 80% of that £100 on goods from other firms, who then pay it out as wages again, and those workers spend 80% of that, and so on. Does the initial £100 injection raise income just once, or does it keep raising income and spending through further rounds?
steps.right: It keeps raising income and spending through further rounds
steps.wrong: It raises income once and then stops there
